trimgs@30000.note: Same method names (trimgs for garden/stump, trimgs-indoor for counter) with --steps 30000 = exactly the flat-3DGS pre-training = the paper's '3DGS*' row. Lets us measure Delta(Trim3DGS - 3DGS*) on identical runtime; paper: garden -0.11, stump +0.06, counter -0.07 dB.

notes: 37000 = 30000 flat-3DGS pre-train + 7000 Trim fine-tune (official tune.py). Normal weight per official run_Mipnerf360.py: outdoor 0.1 (trimgs), indoor 0.01 (trimgs-indoor). Compare against baseline3dgs-mipnerf360-30000 (non-flat) and, better, the optional 30000-step trimgs runs (flat, paper's 3DGS*). bicycle avoided: flat 3DGS used 1.48x the Gaussians of gsplat at 2k steps, bicycle baseline already 6.6M (12M budget). First job JIT-compiles ss_trimgs_cuda (~1 min). Fine-tune adds an extra rasterization pass per step plus ~6 trimming passes over all train views and ~14 CPU kNN (5 s each at 5M). Headline geometry claims (DTU Chamfer, Tables 1-2) are out of scope.
